label: Object color
description: Named surface colors, including muted shades, vivid hues, neutrals, and metallic colors.
notes: Named colors belong here, including conventional metallic color names; object.material holds substances and object.pattern holds surface motifs. Values are short color names that follow “colored,” with visual glosses distinguishing hue, lightness, and saturation. Color names describe approximate visual ranges rather than standardized swatches, and metallic entries specify appearance rather than construction. Families are browsing aids, with boundary colors placed in the family most useful for finding them; the list is closed to keep draws within this curated palette.
